description: This file defines the implementation of the IMediaLogService interface, including the BpMediaLogService proxy class and the onTransact method for handling IPC calls related to media logging.

classes.name: BpMediaLogService
classes.description: Proxy class for the IMediaLogService interface, enabling IPC communication with the media log service.

methods.name: registerWriter
methods.description: Sends a request to register a media log writer with specified shared memory, size, and name.

methods.name: unregisterWriter
methods.description: Sends a request to unregister a media log writer associated with shared memory.

methods.name: requestMergeWakeup
methods.description: Requests a wakeup merge operation in the media log service.
